  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, invoice
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY

  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/API_AnalyzeExpense.html

output_text:
```python
import os
from mindee import Client, TypeInvoiceV4
from mindee.typing import FileInput

def extract_expense_fields(file_path: str) -> dict:
    """
    Extract expense fields from an invoice document using Mindee's Invoice OCR API
    and normalize them into a standard JSON schema.
    
    Args:
        file_path (str): Path to the invoice document
        
    Returns:
        dict: Normalized expense fields in standard JSON schema
    """
    # Initialize Mindee client with API key from environment
    mindee_client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("MINDEE_API_KEY"))
    
    # Load and parse the document
    input_doc = mindee_client.source_from_path(file_path)
    result = mindee_client.parse(TypeInvoiceV4, input_doc)
    
    # Extract and normalize fields
    invoice = result.document.inference.prediction
    
    normalized_fields = {
        "vendor": {
            "name": invoice.supplier.name,
            "address": invoice.supplier.address,
            "tax_id": invoice.supplier.tax_id
        },
        "customer": {
            "name": invoice.customer.name,
            "address": invoice.customer.address,
            "tax_id": invoice.customer.tax_id
        },
        "invoice": {
            "number": invoice.invoice_number,
            "date": invoice.invoice_date,
            "due_date": invoice.due_date,
            "currency": invoice.currency,
            "total_amount": float(invoice.total_amount),
            "tax_amount": float(invoice.total_tax)
        },
        "line_items": [
            {
                "description": item.description,
                "quantity": float(item.quantity),
                "unit_price": float(item.unit_price),
                "total_amount": float(item.total_amount)
            }
            for item in invoice.line_items
        ]
    }
    
    return normalized_fields
```
